verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a SaaS team inbox, but the evidence documents no export feature or open-format bulk download. The REST API endpoints for conversations and contacts are developer building blocks, local attachment downloads are an adjacent feature, and two-way Gmail sync is a property of the host email provider. None of these counts as a product-provided export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
